Newspaper laws issued in 1900

page_data.en:
NEWSPAPER LAW.
(Law No. 41 issued in May 1909).
We sanction hereby the Newspaper Law approved by the Diet
and order the same to be promulgated.
-------
Art. 1 -- A Newspaper, according to the meaning of this Law, is
a literary work intended for regular periodical
publication under a given name or title or, it may be
a literary work not published at regular intervals
but appearing at least once in 6 months, as also any
extra literary work supplementary to the newspaper
and published with the same name or title.
Newspaper having the same title but published
different localities shall be considered as separate
newspapers.
Art. 2 -- Persons specified hereunder are not permitted to hold
the Editorship or Proprietorship of a newspaper:
1. Any person not residing within the Imperial
domains or territory where this law is in force.
2. Any person belonging to the Army or Navy, whether
on active service or under Government orders.
3. A minor or an incompetent person or a quasi
incompetent person
4. Any person actually serving a sentence, or detained
in prison, or the execution of whose sentence has
been deferred.
Art. 3 -- The printing office shall not be established beyond the
limit of the Imperial domains or territory where this
law is in force.
Art. 4 -- The publisher of a newspaper shall report the following
particulars to the Minister for Home Affairs:
1. The title of the newspaper.
2. The character or nature of the articles to be
inserted.
page_data.zh:
报纸律。
（1909年5月颁布的第41号法律）。
兹批准经帝国议会通过的报纸律，并命令予以公布。
-------
第一条 -- 根据本法之含义，报纸是指以特定名称或标题定期出版的文学著作，或者虽非定期出版但每六个月至少出版一次的文学著作，以及作为报纸补充并以相同名称或标题出版的任何增刊文学著作。
具有相同标题但在不同地点出版的报纸应视为不同的报纸。
第二条 -- 下列人员不得担任报纸的主编或业主：
1. 任何不居住于帝国疆域或本法施行领土内的人员。
2. 任何属于陆军或海军的人员，无论是在现役期间还是奉政府命令服役。
3. 未成年人、无行为能力人或准无行为能力人。
4. 任何正在服刑、被监禁或缓刑执行的人员。
第三条 -- 印刷所不得设立在帝国疆域或本法施行领土范围之外。
第四条 -- 报纸发行人应向内务大臣报告以下事项：
1. 报纸的名称。
2. 拟刊登文章的性质或类别。

3. Whether current events will be inserted or not.
4. Whether the newspaper is to be published at
regular periods or not. If regular, at what
periods.
5. Date of first publication.
6. Address or addresses of the publishing and
printing offices.
7. The name of the owner. If the owner is a
juridical person, the name of the person and
the name of the representative.
8. The names and ages of the publisher and the
editor. If there be more than one editor,
the name and age of the editor-in-chief.
The preceding shall be reported to the local
competent authorities, signed jointly by the owner or the
juridical person and the editor ten or more days before
the appearance of the first issue.
Art. 5 -- In the event of Nos. 1-3 of the first clause of the
preceding Article being altered, report shall be made
to the Minister for Home Affairs ten or more days
before the alteration is made under the same procedure
as laid down in the said Article; if No. 4 or 5 or the
owner or the editor is to be changed, report shall be
made to the Minister before any change is effected or
within seven days after. In case the owner is changed,
the old and new owners or his or their juridical person
or persons shall sign the report, except in case of death.
Art. 6 -- A successor who succeeds to the rights and obligations of
a deceased publisher or a publisher who comes under Art.
2, shall make report within seven days after the date
of his succession according to the preceding Article.
In These cases, except the case of the preceding
clause, the report shall be made ten or more days before
the change of a publisher.

3. 是否刊登时事新闻。
4. 报纸是否定期出版。如定期出版，刊期为何。
5. 首次出版日期。
6. 发行所及印刷所的地址。
7. 业主姓名。如业主为法人，则需注明法人名称及代表人姓名。
8. 发行人及主编的姓名和年龄。如有多名编辑，需注明总编辑的姓名和年龄。
上述事项应在首期出版前十日以上，由业主或法人及主编共同签署，向当地主管当局报告。
第五条 -- 如前条第一款第1至3项发生变更，应在变更前十日以上，按照该条规定的相同程序向内务大臣报告；如第4或第5项发生变更，或业主或主编发生更换，应在变更生效前或变更后七日内向内务大臣报告。如业主发生变更，除死亡情况外，新旧业主或其法人代表应在报告上联合签署。
第六条 -- 继承已故发行人权利和义务的继承人，或因符合第二条规定而接任的发行人，应根据前条规定，在接任之日起七日内进行报告。
在这些情况下，除前款所述情况外，应在发行人变更前十日以上进行报告。

Art. 7 -- A newspaper not published within one hundred days
from the reported date of intended publication, or
having ceased publication does not resume publication
within one hundred days of last publication, or a
periodical publishing three issues in one hundred
days fails to produce the three issues in one hundred
days shall be deemed as having become defunct.
Art. 8 -- In case a publisher or an editor dies, or happens to
come under Art. 2, and a successor is not appointed,
or in case a publisher or an editor absents himself
for more than one month beyond the Imperail domains
or territory where this Law is in force, the newspaper
concerned shall not be allowed to continue publication
unless a temporary publisher or a temporary editor is
appointed.
The stipulation in this Law relating to a publisher
or an editor shall apply equally to a temporary publisher
or a temporary editor.
Art. 9 -- The stipulation in this Law relating to the responsi-
bilities of an editor shall also apply to persons
specified hereunder:
1. He who is not an editor but actually engages in
the editing of a newspaper.
2. He who signs his name as author of any article
inserted in a newspaper.
3. He who demands the insertion of a correction or
refutation.
Art.10 -- The names of the publisher, editor, printer, and the
address of the publisher office shall be stated in a
newspaper.
Art.11 -- When a newspaper is issued, two copies of it shall be
sent in to the Home Department, one copy to the Competent
Local Government, and one each to the public procurators'
offices of the Local Courts and the District Courts.

第七条 -- 自报告的预定出版之日起一百日内未出版的报纸，或停止出版后在最后一次出版之日起一百日内未恢复出版的报纸，或在百日内出版三期的定期刊物未能在百日内出版三期的，应视为已停刊。
第八条 -- 如发行人或主编死亡，或出现符合第二条规定的情况，且未指定继任者，或如发行人或主编离开帝国疆域或本法施行领土超过一个月，除非任命临时发行人或临时主编，否则相关报纸不得继续出版。
本法中关于发行人或主编的规定同样适用于临时发行人或临时主编。
第九条 -- 本法中关于主编责任的规定也适用于下列人员：
1. 虽非主编但实际上从事报纸编辑工作的人。
2. 在报纸上刊登的文章中署名为作者的人。
3. 要求刊登更正或辩驳文章的人。
第十条 -- 报纸上应载明发行人、主编、印刷人的姓名，以及发行所的地址。
第十一条 -- 报纸发行时，应将两份送交内务省，一份送交当地主管政府，当地法院和地方裁判所的检察官办公室各送交一份。

Art.12 -- A newspaper intending to publish current events shall
not be allowed publication unless undermentioned sums
of money have been deposited as security with the
Competent Local Government:
1. Yen 2000 for a newspaper to be published in
Tokyo or Osaka, or their neighbourhood within
the distance of 3 ri.
2. Yen 1000 for a newspaper in a city or a division
containing more than 70,000 population, or
neighbourhood within the distance of 1 ri.
3. Yen 500 for a newspaper in other places.
Half the amount of security as in the preceding
clause shall be deposited for a newspaper less than 3
issues a month.
A negotiable paper named by the Government can
be used as security.
Art.13.-- In case a publisher is changed, the successor shall
succeed to the rights and obligations on the security.
Art.14 -- The security shall not be returned nor transferred
unless the newspaper becomes defunct, except for the
execution of a decision of the Law For Collecting
National Tax or ordinances to which the Law For
Collecting National Tax are applicable, or of a claim
against offences of damages for honour.
Art.15 -- Should a publisher or an editor of a newspaper
depositing security fail to pay the full amount of a
fine or the costs of any action relating to the newspaper
within ten days from the date of decision, the public
procurator may appropriate a part or the whole of the
security to meet payment.
Art.16 -- When a deficit in the full amount of security occurs
and such deficit is not made good, the publication of
the newspaper shall not be allowed after seven days from
the date on which such deficit occurs.

第十二条 -- 意图出版时事新闻的报纸，除非向当地主管政府存入下列金额的保证金，否则不得出版：
1. 在东京或大阪，或其周边三里范围内的地区出版的报纸，保证金为2000日元。
2. 在人口超过7万的城市或分区，或其周边一里范围内的地区出版的报纸，保证金为1000日元。
3. 在其他地区出版的报纸，保证金为500日元。
每月出版不足三期的报纸，应存入前款规定金额一半的保证金。
可以使用政府指定的有价证券作为保证金。
第十三条 -- 如发行人发生变更，继任者应承继保证金相关的权利和义务。
第十四条 -- 除非报纸停刊，否则保证金不得退还或转让，但用于执行《国税征收法》或适用该法的条例所作出的决定，或针对损害名誉罪的索赔除外。
第十五条 -- 如缴纳保证金的报纸发行人或主编未在判决之日起十日内支付全额罚款或与报纸有关的任何诉讼费用，检察官可没收部分或全部保证金以抵付。
第十六条 -- 如保证金全额出现短缺且未予补足，自出现短缺之日起七日后，不得允许该报纸出版。

Art.17 -- When the insertion of a correction or refutation of
an article in a newspaper is requested by a person to
whom the said article has made reference or by any
person directly connected with the person concerned,
the whole of the correction or refutation must be
inserted, if it be a written one, in the following
or next following issue counting from the time the
newspaper receives the request.
If the purport of the correction or refutation is
in contravention of the ordinance or if the name and
address of the complainant are not given, it will not
be obligatory to make any insertion.
If the number of words of a correction or refutation
exceed the number of words of an original article, a
charge may be made for the excess at the advertisement
rate of the newspaper.

Art.18 -- If a newspaper insert an article abstracted from the
Official Gazette or from other newspapers, and the Official
Gazette or other newspapers have made a correction or
inserted a refutation, the newspaper reproducing the
article should also reproduce the correction or insert
the refutation without any demand being made for same by
the person concerned or representative, under the
procedure as laid down in the preceding Article, but no
charge shall be claimed for publishing such correction
or refutation.

Art19 -- No newspaper is allowed to publish articles regarding
to the preliminary examination of an article before the
trial takes place, or articles regarding enquiry or
preliminary examination prohibited by a public procurator,
or articles regarding the debatement of an action
forbidden for admittance.

Art.20 -- No newspaper is allowed to publish any document pertaining
to government offices, public offices, or meetings

第十七条 -- 当报纸上刊登的文章所涉及之人，或与该人有直接关系之人要求刊登更正或辩驳文章时，如为书面材料，必须自报纸收到请求之时起，在下一期或再下一期中全文刊登更正或辩驳内容。
如更正或辩驳的要旨违反法令，或未提供投诉人的姓名和地址，则无义务刊登。
如更正或辩驳文章的字数超过原文章字数，超出部分可按报纸广告费率收费。

第十八条 -- 如报纸刊登摘自《官报》或其他报纸的文章，且《官报》或其他报纸已刊登更正或辩驳文章，则转载该文章的报纸也应转载更正或刊登辩驳文章，无需相关人员或其代表提出要求，程序依照前条规定执行，但刊登此类更正或辩驳文章不得收取费用。

第十九条 -- 任何报纸不得刊登有关审判前初步审查的文章，不得刊登检察官禁止的调查或初步审查相关文章，也不得刊登禁止受理的诉讼辩论相关文章。

第二十条 -- 任何报纸不得刊登涉及政府机关、公共机关或根据未公开法令组成的会议的文件，

( 6 )
constituted under an ordinance not made public, or any
proceedings of a meeting not opened publicly without
first obtaining permission. This Article shall also
apply to a petition or appeal.
Art.21 -- No newspaper is allowed to insert such article or
articles as to incite offences or protect them, or to
praise or help or entrap accused.
Art.22 -- If any newspaper neglect to make report of Articles 4-6
or make a false report, or to deposit security or to make
good the deficit of security, the local Competent
Authorities may suspend the publication until it does so.
Art.23 -- When the Minister of Home Department considers an article
inserted in a newspaper will disturb the public peace or
order, or bring deleterious effect upon public morals, he
may prohibit the sale or distribution of the newspaper,
or may distrain it if necessary.
Art.24 -- When the Minister of Home Department considers an article
or articles inserted in a newspaper issued in a foreign
country or in the Imperial domains or territory where
this Law is not in force, will disturb the public peace
or order, or bring deleterious effect upon public morals,
he may prohibit the sale or distribution of such
newspaper in places where this Law is in force or may
distrain it if necessary.
The Minister of Home Department may prohibit
importation of a newspaper, which has been dealt with
the preceding clause more than once in a year, to places
where this Law is in force.
Art.25 -- The Local Competent Authorities may distrain a newspaper
violating the order prohibited by the second clause of
the preceding Article, or a newspaper printed for the
purpose of sale or distribution contrary to the
decision prohibited by Article 43.

或未经事先许可刊登非公开会议的议事记录。本条也适用于请愿书或上诉状。
第二十一条 -- 任何报纸不得刊登煽动犯罪或包庇犯罪的文章，也不得刊登赞扬、帮助或诱陷被告的文章。
第二十二条 -- 如任何报纸未按第四至六条规定进行报告或作虚假报告，或未存入保证金或未补足保证金短缺部分，当地主管当局可暂停其出版，直至其履行上述义务。
第二十三条 -- 如内务大臣认为报纸上刊登的文章将扰乱公共和平或秩序，或对公共道德产生有害影响，可禁止该报纸的销售或分发，或在必要时予以扣押。
第二十四条 -- 如内务大臣认为在外国或帝国疆域及本法未施行的领土内发行的报纸上刊登的文章，将扰乱公共和平或秩序，或对公共道德产生有害影响，可禁止此类报纸在本法施行地区销售或分发，或在必要时予以扣押。
对于一年内多次因前款规定受到处理的报纸，内务大臣可禁止其进口到本法施行地区。
第二十五条 -- 当地主管当局可扣押违反前条第二款禁令命令的报纸，或违反第四十三条禁令决定而为销售或分发目的印刷的报纸。

Art.26 -- If a newspaper distrained under this Law be not released
in two or more years, the Administrative Competent
Authorities who have distrained the newspaper can
dispose of it.

Art.27 -- The Minister of War, of Navy or of Foreign Affairs may
prohibit or restrict by order insertion of an article
relating to military or diplomatic affairs.

Art.28 -- Any person who comes under the provision of Art. 2 and
becomes to a publisher or an editor by making false
report shall be punished to a penal servitude not more
than 3 months, or to a fine not more than yen 50.

Art.29 -- Any person who violates the provision of Art.3 shall be
punished to a fine not exceeding yen 300.

Art.30 -- The publisher shall be punished to a fine not exceeding
yen 100, if he does not make report according to the
provisions of Art. 4-6 or makes report which is not true,
or makes an act contrary to the report relating to No. 1
or Nos. 4-6 of the first clause of Art. 4, or violates
the provision of Art. 11.

Art.31 -- The publisher and editor shall be punished to a fine
not exceeding yen 100, if they act contrary to the report
relating to No. 2 or Nos 3 of the first clause of Art.4.

Art.32 -- (I can not understand the meaning of this Art. at all).

Art.33 -- The publisher and editor shall be punished to a fine not
exceeding yen 100, if they violates the provision of
Art. 10 or insert an article biassedly interpreted.

Art.34 -- The publisher shall be punished to a fine not exceeding
yen 300, if he violates the provisions of the first or
second clause of Art.12 or Art.16, or violates the order
of prohibition under the provision of Art.22.

Art.35 -- The editor shall be punished to a fine not exceeding
yen 50, if he violates the provisions of the first or
second clause of Art. 17 or Art. 18.

In case the offence of the preceding clause relates
to a private matter, it is to be indicted when appealed.
page_data.zh:
( 7 )
1954
18.5.8

第二十六条 -- 如根据本法被扣押的报纸在两年或以上时间内未被释放，扣押该报纸的行政主管当局可对其进行处置。

第二十七条 -- 陆军大臣、海军大臣或外务大臣可通过命令禁止或限制刊登有关军事或外交事务的文章。

第二十八条 -- 任何符合第二条规定并通过虚假报告成为发行人或主编的人，应处以不超过三个月的监禁，或不超过50日元的罚款。

第二十九条 -- 任何违反第三条规定的人，应处以不超过300日元的罚款。

第三十条 -- 如发行人未按第四至六条规定进行报告或作虚假报告，或其行为与第四条第一款第1项或第4-6项的报告不符，或违反第十一条规定，应处以不超过100日元的罚款。

第三十一条 -- 如发行人和主编的行为与第四条第一款第2项或第3项的报告不符，应处以不超过100日元的罚款。

第三十二条 -- （我完全无法理解本条的含义）。

第三十三条 -- 如发行人和主编违反第十条规定或刊登带有偏见解释的文章，应处以不超过100日元的罚款。

第三十四条 -- 如发行人违反第十二条第一款或第二款、或第十六条的规定，或违反第二十二条规定的禁令命令，应处以不超过300日元的罚款。

第三十五条 -- 如主编违反第十七条第一款或第二款、或第十八条的规定，应处以不超过50日元的罚款。
如前款所述罪行涉及私人事务，须在提出上诉时才予以起诉。
